description: This file provides service functions for preparing asset payloads and simulating pushing assets to Meta Ads Manager in a frontend React project. It includes functions for constructing payloads based on asset data and validating environment variables for API credentials, along with simulation of API calls.

methods.name: prepareAssetPayload(asset)
methods.description: Prepares a payload object for a given asset, mapping local asset fields to the format expected for Meta creative uploads. Determines the asset type (image or video) based on the asset object.

methods.name: pushToMeta(payload)
methods.description: Simulates pushing an asset payload to Meta Ads Manager. Validates presence of required environment variables and waits asynchronously for a delay, then returns a success message with a generated ID.
